rendered: The premise does not hold: NFA-A did not fall behind the NCA reference. After 100[1] charge/discharge cycles the document reports NFA-A at ≈80%[2] capacity retention, against ≈68%[3] for the NCA cathode, so NFA-A was ahead. The document says NFA-A had superior capacity retention[4] when compared with NCA in the same voltage range. The retention plot in Fig. 8[5] agrees: at the final cycle the NFA A curve sits above the NCA curve. The document therefore gives no shortfall to report, and the margin is in NFA-A's favour, not against it.
